summary: Tested new Equipment (Sprzet) module backend - 30/30 pytest tests passed. CRUD, auth (admin-only writes, foreman read-only), validation, status filters, employee/site filters, assign/unassign, and 404 handling all work correctly. Regression tests for existing endpoints (health, login, employees, sites, hours, requests, assignments, sync/logs, reports/monthly) all pass - new module did not break anything. 8 demo equipment items seeded for user presentation.

minor.issue: update_doc filter logic in routes/equipment.py:118 is convoluted - currently allows clearing assigned_to_employee_id/site_id/notes/image_data via null but other fields (name/status/category/serial_number) cannot be set to null. Works for current use-case but could be simpler: rely on exclude_unset=True only and trust Pydantic. Not blocking.
No enum validation for status field - any string is accepted (e.g., 'foobar'). Recommend Literal['sprawny','uszkodzony','w_serwisie','wycofany'] in EquipmentCreate/Update for stronger validation.
assigned_to_employee_id and assigned_to_site_id are accepted without verifying the referenced employee/site exists. Could create orphaned references.
No pagination - to_list(2000) hard limit. Acceptable for current scale but should be revisited.

action_items: Frontend: implement SPRZET tab UI (list, add/edit modal with image upload base64, status badges, assign-to-employee/site selectors, delete confirmation) and wire to /api/equipment endpoints. Backend is fully ready.
(Optional) Add Literal-based enum validation for equipment.status field.
(Optional) Validate assigned_to_employee_id / assigned_to_site_id existence in DB before saving.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/equipment.py:118 - the conditional `if v is not None or k in (...)` mixes exclude_unset with conditional null-allowance. Since exclude_unset=True already ensures only provided fields are present in dump, the `is not None` filter prevents setting these fields to null. For 'clear assignment' a separate /assign endpoint exists, so behaviour is OK, but logic could be simplified to just `payload.model_dump(exclude_unset=True)`.
routes/equipment.py - status field stored as plain string without enum/Literal validation. Recommend pydantic Literal type to reject invalid statuses at API boundary.
server.py:83 - default ADMIN_PASSWORD='admin123' fallback is fine for dev but if .env is missing in prod, weak default used. Consider raising on startup if not configured.

auth.py:9 - reads JWT_SECRET_KEY from env, but backend/.env defines JWT_SECRET (mismatch). Currently falls back to hardcoded default 'your-secret-key-change-in-production'. Tokens still work because the same default is used everywhere, but the env value is effectively ignored. Recommend aligning the env var name.
seed_data_creation: 8 demo equipment items inserted via /app/backend/tests/seed_equipment_demo.py - covers all 4 statuses (sprawny, uszkodzony, w_serwisie, wycofany), various categories (Elektronarzedzia, Rusztowania, Maszyny budowlane, Spawanie, Pomiary), some assigned to employees, some to sites. Ready for UI demo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Equipment backend module is fully working and tested. /app/backend/tests/test_equipment.py contains 30 regression tests. Next steps are frontend implementation of the SPRZET tab. The JWT_SECRET env var name mismatch (auth.py looks for JWT_SECRET_KEY) is pre-existing tech debt and not related to equipment feature.
